dispositions.class: A fixture whose $defs or Tool entry is not an object, and a Tool type the library cannot use, becomes McpProfileError.
An inputSchema or outputSchema whose properties value is not an object fails check_schema. Reading B of point 1(a).
A call with a wrong-typed argument, tool name or registry, a non-finite number or a lone surrogate is CAPABILITY_DENIED.
The unit record now has the path inventory, the self-check table, the cell scan and the role coherence scan.
The call helper is not the production capability broker. The decision excludes an MCP server and transport, so grants and the stop epoch stay unwired.
